scope: Bounded offline assessment of existing saved 1.50.10 evidence; no hardware access, payload edit or device mutation.
implementation_status: No return entry or bidirectional runtime switch has been implemented or dynamically validated.

options.entry: Original-app settings button or repeated taps on version page
options.assessment: Best discoverability for a finished product. A handler in the original UI can send a launcher request from the UI-owned lifetime and avoids stealing unrelated touches.
options.confirmed: The original vapp body and application package remain; GUI/JS page lifecycle is present.
options.pending: The actual smartpanel menu/page resource and its edit/validation path have not been located in this bounded review. No existing public switch-button ABI is claimed. Repeated version taps are a proposed gesture, not a discovered feature.

options.entry: Reserved screen-corner long press or gesture
options.assessment: Suitable first experimental on-device trigger if inserted before the original UI receives the gesture. A separate touch subscriber can detect it but cannot consume the original subscriber's copy.

candidate_interception.sample_parse: 0x3806abcc tests flags & 3 for DOWN/MOVE; UP mask 4 clears cached pressed state. Signed x/y are loaded at0x3806abe6/0x3806abec and clamped before writing GUI output.
candidate_interception.required_behavior: Intercept before pressed/coordinates reach the GUI output; consume the complete contact from DOWN through UP, including MOVE and release. Detect a reserved region at DOWN, latch the contact, and queue the switch after release or an explicit cancellation handshake. Do not allow a DOWN to the original UI followed by a swallowed UP.
candidate_interception.pending: This is an identified input-decoding interception point, not a proved mutable callback slot or installed trampoline. Coordinate orientation and the selected corner's collision with original controls still require verification.

options.fanout_proof: touch_event0x380144f0 copies every sample to all per-open rings at0x38014544; current touch ioctl exposes no per-consumer grab/filter.

options.assessment: Can avoid touch ownership ambiguity if a dedicated harmless key exists. Existing setup/reset controls must retain their stock behavior until separately audited.
options.confirmed_candidates: P3_1/P3_2/P3_3 GPIO inputs with pull-ups and firmware key masks8/2/4.
options.pending: Their correspondence to physical keys and the complete key-service callback route are not proved. The user's known configuration action enters setup/reboots; it is not a demonstrated harmless live-switch key.

development_control.original_cli: vapp app/com.xiaomi.smartpanel & starts the application; no examined CLI option implements an external safe stop.
development_control.framework_events: Original main registers event3 and event4 with callbackThumb0x3818f8a1 via0x381af158. Callback0x3818f8ce..0x3818f8fc checks event3/4 and non-NULL globalFramework then invokes vtable+0x10 stop.
development_control.event_post_candidate: 0x381abfec accepts Framework*, event id, active App*. Its async branch locks impl+0x118 for the event queue, then notifies UV async handleimpl+0x48. This is queue synchronization, not proof of Framework/App lifetime ownership.
development_control.limit: Suitable as a controlled development route only after a serialized lifetime/readiness handshake. Events3/4 are framework events, not OSsignal numbers. Arbitrary watcher calls cannot be declared safe merely because uv_async_send is thread-safe.

pending_reentry_audit.global_clear_confirmed: Original main calls destroy at0x3818fb30, deleting destructor at0x3818fb3c, then storesNULL to global0x3850260c at0x3818fb40. NULL is not published until after object deletion.
pending_reentry_audit.signal_cleanup_gap: Main installs signal2 handlerThumb0x3818f949 at0x3818fb00 and its entire observed exit path contains no restoration. Handler0x3818f98a..0x3818f9a2 dereferences globalFramework and activeApp without NULL guards. A launcher must account for its task/signal ownership before claiming repeated invocation safe.
pending_reentry_audit.constructor_destructor: Fresh Framework constructor allocates new impl; destructor0x381a9230 releases event buffers, mutex and impl; deleting destructor0x381a92dc frees object. Framework stop0x381a93a0 does not lock/refcount the object and asserts if activeApp isNULL.
pending_reentry_audit.initialization_guard: Framework init0x381a5a44 checks persistent GUI initialization byte0x384fc860, skips0x38056bf0 if already initialized, and still invokes0x3806a218 plus gui_context_init0x381b5bf4. GUI context uninit0x381b7988..0x381b8098 clears many GUI global containers. This is partial reinitialization evidence, not proof that all shared driver/UI resources support unlimited reentry.
pending_reentry_audit.required_dynamic_check: RAM-only cooperative original->custom->original round trip, serialized stop/return acknowledgement, no concurrent renderer/input delivery, no old scanout source freed while queued, globalNULL after return, valid fresh framework after reentry, unchanged board-driver identities and no growing stale subscriptions/FDs. No such round trip was performed.
